title: Queue Ticket Generation
preconditions: Demo app reset to seed; a demo customer account is selected
expected: Verify that a unique ticket number is created.

title: FIFO Queue Processing
preconditions: Demo app reset to seed; at Central Branch counter 1 (Sarah Johnson) is serving CEN-GC-002 and CEN-GC-003 and CEN-DV-002 are already waiting, so earlier waiting tickets are called first and the three new tickets are called after them in creation order
Staff completes any current Called/Serving ticket before each Call Next
steps: Staff clicks Call Next three times, completing each service between calls.
expected: Verify that tickets are processed in FIFO order.

title: Real-Time Status Synchronization
preconditions: Customer has a Waiting ticket that is next in its branch queue (e.g. Alex Rivera's DWN-GC-003 after the serving ticket is completed)
expected: Verify that customer sees Called status without manually refreshing.

title: Queue Position and Waiting Time
source_ref: TR-4: Queue Position and Waiting Time
expected: Verify that the remaining queue positions and estimated waiting times are recalculated correctly.

title: Appointment Conflict Prevention
preconditions: Demo app reset to seed; Downtown Branch has a single counter
steps: Attempt to book the same staff member or counter at the same time.
expected: Verify that the conflicting appointment is rejected.

title: Admin Analytics
preconditions: Demo app reset to seed (seed totals: 11 tickets today, 3 completed)
steps: Verify that dashboard statistics reflect the actual ticket data.
expected: Verify that dashboard statistics reflect the actual ticket data.
